question: Will the U.S. personal saving rate (BEA, seasonally adjusted) for April 2024 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2024-04-14) be above 6.4%, its value for November 2023?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2024-01-15 (November 2023), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis
